added.title: (USA) Senior Manager, Software Engineering
added.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...Role summary:

The Senior Manager, Software Engineering, leads platform-level execution of software and AI/ML systems, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and roadmap milestones. This role oversees infrastructure, tooling, and frameworks to support scalable, secure development while driving full lifecycle management across multiple teams. The position champions DevOps practices, cloud cost optimization, and technical excellence to deliver high-availability systems. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, the role guides architectural decisions, mentors engineers, and manages complex initiatives to achieve business objectives through innovation, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

About the team:

Our team develops merchant tools that enhance productivity through artificial intelligence, collaborating closely with product, project, and user experience teams. We focus on delivering scalable, high-quality solutions using iterative development, continuous testing, and thorough debugging. Team members apply strong technical expertise in platform design, API development, and object-oriented programming while ensuring seamless integration and deployment. This environment fosters innovation and problem-solving to address business needs effectively. The team emphasizes stakeholder management, project milestones, and technology roadmaps to drive impactful results within a dynamic technology landscape.

What you'll do:

Lead platform-level execution of software and AI/ML systems, ensuring alignment with domain priorities and roadmap milestones.
Oversee shared infrastructure, tooling, and ML frameworks to support scalable, secure development.
Drive full software development lifecycle across multiple teams, championing DevOps architecture and CI/CD practices.
Manage cloud cost optimization and enhance automation, telemetry, and tooling to improve reliability and efficiency.
Mentor engineers, guide architectural decisions, and promote technical quality and compliance standards.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define priorities, track progress, and ensure delivery of complex technical initiatives.
Foster continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance processes, tools, and products.

What you'll bring:

Proven experience leading platform engineering and software development lifecycle across multiple teams.
Strong expertise in DevOps architecture, CI/CD practices, and cloud financial management (FinOps).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex technical initiatives, aligning execution with strategic roadmaps and milestones.
Skilled in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration to drive project delivery and unblock progress.
Proficient in software architecture, system design, and technical decision-making ensuring scalability and maintainability.
Experience mentoring engineers and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
Effective project management skills with a focus on operational excellence and performance metrics.

At Sam's Club, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet!

Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage
Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance
Paid time off benefits include PTO, parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable.

For information about PTO, see https://one.walmart.com/notices.

Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more.

Live Better U is a company paid education benefit program for full-time and part-time associates in Walmart and Sam's Club facilities. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.

added.title: Director, Gulf Coast Engineering Research Station
added.description:
Overview

This position is located in Orange Beach, Alabama

The Samuel Ginn College of Engineering (SGCOE) is excited to begin the search for the Director of the Gulf Coast Engineering Research Center
. This position is responsible for developing the long-term vision and strategies for the Center, ensuring it gains a prominent role in applied research and innovation in water quality and quantity and coastal resilience across the Gulf Coast region.

To learn more about the center click here Gulf Coast Engineering Research Station

Special Instructions:
Candidates are required to upload a resume and cover letter with their application. Please combine into one document.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership — Develops long-term vision, strategies, and tactics for the Center, establishing it as a leader in applied research on water quality and quantity, coastal resilience, and related environmental and engineering challenges. Works closely with leadership on the main campus to maintain alignment with overall university research priorities.
Research Management — Oversees Center research staff and project leads to ensure goals are achieved within budget and time constraints and that projects are carried out with high quality. Promotes interdisciplinary work spanning water resources, coastal and ecological engineering, and environmental science.
Funding and Budgeting — Works with main-campus leadership to secure operational support for the Center. Focuses significant effort on engaging external funding agencies (e.g., NOAA, EPA, USACE, NSF, state environmental and coastal agencies) and identifying research opportunities for Center staff and main-campus researchers. Manages the Center's budget to allocate and utilize resources effectively.
Team Building and Management — Recruits, mentors, and oversees a team of researchers and professional staff. Fosters a collaborative environment and promotes continuous growth.
Community and Stakeholder Engagement — Engages with coastal communities, industry, resource managers, and government stakeholders to ensure the Center's work aligns with regional needs and priorities. Facilitates engagement of main-campus faculty and students with Center activities and the Orange Beach and broader Gulf Coast community.
Reporting — Provides regular reports to senior college leaders and stakeholders on the Center's progress, achievements, challenges, and future plans. Conducts activities with input from a Center advisory council.

Qualifications

Master's Degree in Engineering or Science or a related field and 10 years of experience in high-level leadership of a complex research organization, ideally in water resources, coastal/environmental engineering, or marine science. Demonstrated experience securing extramural funds from federal and state agencies and the private sector for applied research.

Contract Type

Continuing

added.title: Director, Perception - Autonomous Vehicles
added.description:
Job Requisition ID JR2014459

Job Category Engineering

Time Type Full time

Achieving what has never been accomplished requires foresight, creativity, and the finest talent worldwide! We are looking for a driven Director of Perception to help lead our AI model evolution. In this critical leadership role, you will drive the development of state-of-the-art deep learning models that enable our vehicles to see, understand, and navigate complex environments. You will lead teams pushing the boundaries of modern network architectures to deliver a robust, real-time 3D world model. If you are a relentless problem-solver who thrives on building world-class teams and shipping production AI, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead and Inspire: Manage, mentor, and scale a high-performing organization of engineering managers, applied researchers, and software engineers dedicated to autonomous vehicle perception.
Drive the Architecture: Guide the strategic direction, design, and execution of modern network architectures (e.g., Transformers, BEV, Occupancy Networks, Vision-Language-Action models) for multi-sensor fusion (camera, LiDAR, radar) and real-time 3D world reconstruction.
End-to-End Ownership: Oversee the entire machine learning lifecycle—from active learning, data mining, and synthetic data generation to model training, model performance acceleration, and deployment on NVIDIA DRIVE platforms (Orin/Thor).
Cross-Functional Teamwork: Partner closely with leaders across Planning and Control, Mapping, Hardware, and Safety teams to ensure seamless integration of the perception stack and alignment on AV system-level metrics.
Cultivate Excellence: Foster a culture of radical ownership, high-velocity execution, and continuous innovation. Ensure all algorithms and production code adhere to strict automotive quality and safety standards (e.g., ISO 26262).

What We Need To See

Ph.D. or master's degree in computer science, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, visual computing, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
10+ overall years of industry experience in deep learning, computer vision, or autonomous robotics, with at least 5+ years in a senior leadership role managing large teams or multiple layers of management.
Deep, hands-on theoretical and practical expertise with modern network architectures (Transformers, CNNs, Foundation Models) and complex multi-sensor fusion paradigms.
A proven track record of successfully deploying production-grade, safety-critical machine learning models to edge/embedded computing platforms.
Strong foundational knowledge in Python, C++, and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow).
Exceptional communication and leadership skills. You must be able to distill complex technical uncertainty into clear, actionable strategies for both your team and executive leadership.
A highly motivated, entrepreneurial mindset. You possess a relentless drive to solve the hardest problems in the AV space and the energy to lead a team through the challenges of shipping bleeding-edge technology.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Demonstrated success in shipping autonomous vehicle software to mass-production.
A recognized presence in the global AI/CV community, evidenced by top-tier publications (CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS) or significant open-source contributions.
Hands-on experience with next-generation paradigms, such as end-to-end autonomous driving architectures, Large Vision Models (LVMs), or sim-to-real transfer techniques.
Deep understanding of hardware-software co-design, specifically optimizing modern networks for NVIDIA GPU architectures.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world working here. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

#AutonomousVehicles

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 320,000 USD - 488,750 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 14, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

added.description:
Denver, CO

Engineering – Optical Engineering /

Full-Time /

On-site

apply for this job

Xcimer Energy leverages decades of research on Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) combined with groundbreaking new laser architecture. Our mission is to deploy fusion power plants to meet global decarbonization goals as fast as possible. Xcimer has assembled a team of leaders in tough tech, fusion science, and manufacturing with a track record of rapid execution. Supported by leading investors, Xcimer is uniquely positioned to deliver limitless, clean, fusion power to combat climate change. Join us in powering a better world with inertial fusion!

This is a full-time, onsite role based at our headquarters in Denver, CO.

As a Director of Optical Engineering
you will lead the department which staffs the design, development, qualification and commissioning of state-of-the-art UV laser optical systems for laser-driven inertial fusion. This role combines deep technical expertise in optical engineering with organizational leadership responsibility for the Optical Engineering team. You will be responsible for building and leading a high-performing team of optical engineers while providing technical direction for the design, analysis, integration, and validation of laser beamlines, diagnostics, optical coatings, adaptive optics systems, and other critical optical subsystems.

As a member of the engineering leadership team, you will partner closely with scientists, systems engineers, optical physicists, opto-mechanical engineers, and program leadership to ensure that the optical architectures, technical roadmaps, risks, and delivery of optical systems, is accomplished in accordance with the requirements of Xcimer's Fusion and Directed Energy missions. We are looking for a leader who combines exceptional technical depth with strong people leadership, execution discipline, and a passion for solving some of the world's most challenging engineering problems, while very comfortable working in a matrix organization.

Responsibilities

Organizational Leadership

Build, lead, mentor, and grow the Optical Engineering team through hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.
Establish team goals, priorities, staffing plans, and organizational capabilities aligned with company objectives.
Develop engineering processes, design standards, documentation practices, and quality expectations for the optical engineering organization.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Partner with executive leadership to develop long-term optical engineering strategy and organizational growth plans.

Technical Leadership

Oversee the development of optical architectures for laser beamlines, diagnostics, adaptive optics systems, beam transport systems, and related optical subsystems.
Work with science, systems engineering, and laser teams to derive, allocate, and manage optical system requirements.
Provide technical oversight for optical design, tolerancing, alignment strategies, and system performance analyses.
Chair reviews of optical designs and analyses, ensuring technical rigor and adherence to performance requirements.
Guide development of active beam control systems including adaptive optics, beam stabilization, and tracking systems.
Ensure that requirements and specifications for optical components, coatings, imaging systems, cameras, sensors, and precision optical assemblies are established in compliance with the Xcimer Product Development Process.
Drive resolution of complex optical performance issues through modeling, experimentation, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Oversee optical system integration, alignment, verification, validation, and commissioning activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with optomechanical engineering teams to optimize system performance, manufacturability, alignment accessibility, and maintainability.
Collaborate with optical physicists, electrical engineers, controls engineers, and software engineers to develop integrated laser and diagnostic systems.
Support supplier selection, technical evaluations, and strategic relationships with optical component vendors and manufacturing partners.
Work closely with program management to identify risks, develop mitigation plans, and ensure successful execution of program milestones.
Present technical status, risks, and recommendations to engineering leadership and executive stakeholders.

Qualifications

Education: MS degree in Optical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
Experience: 10+ years of experience in optical engineering, including optical design, analysis, integration, and testing of complex optical systems.
Leadership: 15+ years of experience leading technical teams and managing engineering organizations.
Demonstrated expertise using optical design software such as Zemax (preferred), CODE V, or equivalent tools.
Strong experience with computational analysis tools such as MATLAB, Python, or similar engineering software.
Deep understanding of optical design methodologies, optimization techniques, and performance metrics for imaging and laser systems.
Experience with optical tolerancing, fabrication specifications, statistical performance analysis, and alignment sensitivity assessments.
Experience integrating and aligning complex optical systems using instrumentation such as theodolites, autocollimators, laser trackers, interferometers, and related metrology equipment.
Experience performing optical metrology and characterization, including interferometric measurements, surface quality assessment, scatter characterization, and precision inspection techniques.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering efforts from concept through integration and testing.
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Desired

Ph.D. degree in Optical Engineering, Optical Science, Physics, or a related discipline.
15+ years of experience in optical system design, optimization, tolerancing, integration, and precision alignment.
Experience working in a Matrix Organization delivering multiple projects and programs in parallel.
Experience leading optical engineering organizations supporting large-scale technical programs.
Experience designing adaptive optics systems and beam pointing stabilization systems.
Experience performing high-fidelity physical optics modeling and wavefront propagation analyses in both near-field and far-field regimes.
Experience with high-energy laser systems and deep ultraviolet (UV) optical systems.
Experience developing comprehensive end-to-end optical system models and performance budgets.
Experience defining and flowing requirements from system-level architectures to subsystem and component specifications.
Experience supporting development of advanced scientific, aerospace, defense, fusion, or directed-energy systems.
Demonstrated success scaling engineering teams in fast-paced, high-growth technical organizations.

$190,000 - $220,000 a year

Candidates may be considered for other positions at Xcimer Energy, and our actual base salary will be determined on an individual basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. The range is published in accordance with Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act and California Equal Pay Act.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Xcimer Energy is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified, diverse, and dedicated work force. Xcimer Energy hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork, in which all employees recognize and appreciate the diversity of individual team members. Benefits

Xcimer offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employee health, well-being, and long-term success. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; basic and supplemental life insurance; short- and long-term disability; paid parental leave for employees at the time of birth or adoption; and a 401(k) with a company match of up to 6%. Eligible employees also receive equity, allowing them to share in the company’s long-term success.

Xcimer operates under a flexible Paid Time Off (ATO) approach. Rather than a fixed number of vacation days, employees are trusted to take the time they need to rest and recharge while meeting the expectations of their role and team. In addition, employees receive paid sick time, 13 company-paid holidays, and an annual paid company shutdown. Benefits are available to regular employees, including part-time and fixed-term roles, as well as interns, with eligibility varying by benefit.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
